item.title: Week 10: Steelers at Bengals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: CIN -3.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CIN 59% vs. market 66% | On paper Cincinnati has the edge (Cincinnati ranks 1st in EPA per dropback, +0.33), while Pittsburgh's best counter is to break tackles (Pittsburgh ranks 1st in broken tackles per touch, 7.4%). Under center, Joe Burrow ranks 1st of 31 in EPA per dropback and Aaron Rodgers ranks 27th; x-factor: Jaylen Warren gains +2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, 1st of 34, and Cincinnati's run defense ranks 26th. The model favors Cincinnati at 59%, mostly on starting QB (3.8 pts) and passing matchup (3.4 pts).
